items.q: He played in the trio that I opened up with.

ctx.x: Did he play bass in Puerto Rico?
He played in the trio that I opened up with. /There's another great Puerto Rican musician that's down there, a trombone player.
Oh, Arbello. He's with Don Redman, oh yes, of course. (Fernando Arbello, trombonist)
